question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beat.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beat.action: Loose halftone paper documents drift down and lock together into one tile at centre frame.

sources: Diginex (DGNX) is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: soft violet. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a paper document stack; a cream paper tile.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: Loose halftone paper documents drift down and lock together into one tile at centre frame.
Ends holding on the stacked tile.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "ONE PLATFORM".

COPY LIST: "ONE PLATFORM". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, modern editorial paper collage with a refined 2D motion design style. The scene is set against a single, dominant flat block-color background of soft violet, featuring a matte printed paper texture without any gradients or glows. On the first frame, several black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of business documents, each featuring rough white torn-paper edges and subtle shadows cast from a consistent upper-left light source, enter the frame quickly from the top. They drift downward with a fast, fluid motion and a slight overshoot before locking together with precision into a single, neat stack. This stack rests upon a flat, matte cream-colored paper tile positioned at the center of the frame. Simultaneously, a large, extra-bold black sans-serif headline "ONE PLATFORM" appears, printed clearly on a white paper chip with rough torn edges, positioned with safe margins. The composition remains stable for the remainder of the video, with the elements holding a clear reading window. A subtle, looping micro-movement of the paper edges persists until the end. (S1), a narrator with a warm, clear, natural, and brisk English voice, speaks the line: <d>[English] Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice, layered with diegetic foley sounds of paper. Distinct, crisp paper-slapping sounds occur as the documents lock together, accompanied by the short, tacky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
